description: Returns a fill-in template for a 1-file client context document (goals, voice, claims rules, priorities, approvals, decisions) for a service line. Use when the user wants AI tools or new teammates to stop needing a client re-brief.

client_name.description: Optional client name to put in the title.

service_line.description: general, seo, paid_media, content, lifecycle, or automation. Default general.

name: client_context_template
title: Client context file template
